mcp_tools.name: portfolio_risk_analytics_report
mcp_tools.title: Portfolio risk analytics report
mcp_tools.description: Submit a portfolio manifest (returns series, optional benchmark, holdings, factors, stress scenarios, decision journal); get deterministic risk analytics — volatility, drawdown, VaR/CVaR, Sharpe/Sortino, beta/alpha, concentration, carry, factor decomposition — with status complete / partial / insufficient_evidence and every gap named. Numbers only: no recommendations, nothing labeled optimal. A non-advisory computation over submitted data.

inputSchema.description: The portfolio analytics manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and the 6-decimal serialization rule).

benchmark_returns.description: Per-period benchmark returns (numbers), aligned with returns.

holdings.description: Declared holdings with shares/weights, currency, carry fields.

factors.description: Declared factor series for the decomposition.

correlation_window.description: Trailing window for the last-window correlation matrix.

stress_scenarios.description: Caller-submitted stress scenarios (portfolio-level or per-holding shocks).

expect.notes: All inputs provided, series length > 2. Computed spot checks: mean return = 0.006667, sample volatility = 0.025166.
